core_obligations: Presentation of the point: assuming the point is of finite type the proof chooses an affine scheme mapping smoothly to the stack with a closed point over the given point, and forms the groupoid presentation of that point (proof lines 3824-3831)

The morphisms of the groupoid are locally of finite type: the projections are computed as a finite type map followed by a smooth map, hence are locally of finite type and, over a field, flat and locally of finite presentation (proof lines 3832-3847)

The quotient is the residual gerbe: the groupoid is flat and locally of finite presentation, so its quotient is an algebraic stack, and the canonical map from it to the stack is fully faithful and a monomorphism, which identifies it with the residual gerbe by uniqueness (proof lines 3848-3867)

The inclusion is locally of finite type: using the commutative square with the chosen scheme, the proof transfers the property from the base change along the presentation, which is locally of finite type by hypothesis, to the projection of the fibre product, using the fppf descent statement (proof lines 3868-3900)

The remaining implications: the third condition plainly implies the second, and the second implies the first by the identification of finite type points through morphisms and the nonemptiness of the set of finite type points of the singleton stack (proof lines 3902-3909)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(3)：由有限型点的刻画取仿射概型 U 与其闭点 u 使 U → X 光滑、u ↦ x；令 R = u ×_X u 得代数空间群胚 (u,R,s,t,c)。投影 R → u 是「有限型的闭浸入基变换」与「光滑映射基变换」的复合 ⇒ 局部有限型；又 u 是域谱 ⇒ 平坦且局部有限表现。于是 Z = [u/R] 是代数叠，其到 X 的典范映射全忠实、可表示且是单射，由残差 gerbe 的唯一性得 Z ≅ Z_x。
(3)⇒(2) 显然。再用图中的 fppf 覆盖 u ×_X U → Z ×_X U 与下降引理把「局部有限型」搬到 Z ×_X U → U，即 f 局部有限型。
(2)⇒(1)：由本章两条引理（有限型点沿态射的刻画 + 有限型点集非空）得唯一那点是 Z 的有限型点，故 x 是 X 的有限型点。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises finite type points of an algebraic stack as those for which the residual gerbe exists and includes into the stack by a morphism locally of finite type, with an intermediate condition through a singleton stack mapping to the stack (author lemma at source lines 3802-3816, label lemma-point-finite-type-monomorphism). The proof (source lines 3818-3910) builds from a smooth presentation of the point the groupoid presentation of that point, checks that its structure maps are locally of finite type and, over a field, flat and locally of finite presentation, obtains the quotient stack, identifies it with the residual gerbe by the uniqueness statement, and then transfers local finiteness of the inclusion from a base change along an fppf covering by the descent statement; the remaining implications close the circle using the identification of finite type points through morphisms (proof lines 3824-3909). The construction of the residual gerbe from the groupoid presentation is the content. H3.
